map.综合风险 = 温度分 × 0.45 + 湿度分 × 0.40 + 水分分 × 0: Composite risk = temp score x 0.45 + humidity score x 0.40 + moisture score x 0.15; grain temp > 25C and humidity > 70% = high risk
map.温度分按粮温分档（<15℃ 10 分，15~20℃ 25 分，20~25℃ 50: Temp score by grain temperature tiers (<15C 10 pts, 15-20C 25, 20-25C 50, 25-30C 75, >30C 95), humidity by bin relative humidity, moisture by grain safe moisture (slightly high / high add points). Weighted then graded; if grain moisture is over safe by more than 1 point, raise one level even if temp/humidity are mild.
map.💡 判定逻辑：温度>25℃且湿度>70%为高风险；温度20–25℃为中风险；<2: 💡 Logic: temp>25C and humidity>70% is high risk; 20-25C medium; <20C low. Safe moisture differs by grain (rice 13.5%, wheat 12.5%, corn 14%)
map.主要储粮害虫（玉米象、麦蛾、赤拟谷盗）在 25–35℃、相对湿度 70% 以上繁: Major storage pests (rice weevil, Mediterranean flour moth, red flour beetle) breed fastest at 25-35C and relative humidity above 70%
map.粮温低于 15℃ 害虫基本停止活动，低于 10℃ 可有效抑制虫霉: Below 15C pests basically stop; below 10C effectively suppress pests and mold
map.玉米更易感染黄曲霉，安全水分要求更严，建议结合水分综合判断: Corn is more prone to aflatoxin; demands stricter safe moisture, judge with moisture

map.📚 深度解析：仓储虫害爆发温度阈值预警: 📚 Deep Dive: Storage Pest Outbreak Temperature Threshold Alert
map.按虫种发育起点温度与适温上限预警。: Warn by pest development base temperature and upper suitable limit.
map.多数储粮害虫 15℃ 以下停滞、25~35℃ 高发。: Most storage pests stall below 15C and peak at 25-35C.
map.用于储粮温控策略触发。: Used to trigger storage temperature-control strategy.
map.粮温连续 3 天 > 30℃ 且粮堆湿度偏高，谷蠹发育速率达峰值，预警『将爆发』: Grain temp > 30C for 3 days and bulk humidity high, borer development peaks, warns "will outbreak". Immediately ventilate to below 20C and check pest density; if needed aluminum phosphide fumigation (strictly per protocol).
map.温度阈值为什么因虫而异？: Why do temperature thresholds differ by pest?
map.每种害虫有发育起点温度和最适温，如玉米象适 27~30℃、米象稍低。预警需先知道: Each pest has a base and optimum temperature, e.g., rice weevil 27-30C, rice weevil slightly lower. Warning needs the main pest known; no one-size-fits-all.
map.预警后只能熏蒸吗？: Is fumigation the only option after warning?
map.优先物理（降温、降湿、过筛），化学熏蒸是最后手段且需专业与防护。预防（清仓、压盖: Prefer physical (cooling, dehumidifying, screening); chemical fumigation is last resort needing expertise and protection. Prevention (clean bin, covering, temperature control) beats post-outbreak treatment.
